method: Single current/frozen child executions with the same monitored DRIVER and equivalent input bytes/state. Each R07-A perf follow-up facts pair scans the same pin and plain business control. Text and four export template pairs use the same root/arguments and equivalent Git/artifact state. Observe times separately from product gold equality. No claim about unmonitored native performance or statistical stability; no repeated measurement.
